note: A grass opening about 60 m across among conifers on the ridge, reached by a level gravel track of some 200 to 300 ft on the east side of Ridge Road, 3.6 miles south of Stillhouse Road. Not the Gaswell equestrian camping area on Bell Draft Road near Benezette, which shares the name; horses are not allowed here. Stillhouse Road climbs from PA 120 at no more than about 7% over any 1.2 km, then the ridge road is rolling; both are dirt or gravel forest roads. The other way up, Grove Hill Road from PA 120 near Driftwood, holds about 9% for over two miles. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: 052 Gaswell still listed and bookable online, Drive-In, RV/Tent/Trailer categories, 40 ft, clearance 20 ft, pull-in gravel driveway 300 ft (3DEP: level). GIS agrees on trailer access. Fees confirmed, $6.50 fee added; season written; facilities none. Imagery: triangular grass opening ~60 m across with a track entering from the north-west; pin on its east corner, a vehicle-sized object at the pin; not moved. Stated approach (Stillhouse Road) 7.0% over 1.2 km: under the yardstick. NHD: Lick Island Run 176 m.
flags: Access road: page route PA 120 > Stillhouse Road 3.9 mi > Ridge Road south 3.6 mi. Profiled from the point where OSRM picks Stillhouse Road up (3.2 mi of it) plus Ridge Road 3.4 mi: steepest 1.2 km 7.0%, no run of 8%+ as long as 600 m. Under the Spade Road yardstick. OSRM's default route is different and much worse: Grove Hill Road + 'T324' from PA 120 near Driftwood, three back-to-back runs of 8.3-9.0% totalling about 3.7 km (+320 m, steepest 200 m 11.9%), i.e. much longer than Spade Road; the note warns against it.

Name: 'Gaswell' is also the name of a DCNR first-come equestrian camping area on Bell Draft Road (about 5 miles from Benezette). This site is a different place on Ridge Road; its page says 'Limitation: Equestrian camping is not permitted.' Sentence added to the note.
GIS layer: TrailerAccess 'Yes' for this site; agrees with the booking page.

Season written (entry had none): opens 04-01, closes 12-12, from the site page's own statement ('open from the beginning of April through the end of rifle deer season') and 'Status: Open through Sat Dec 12 2026'. The engine's calendar is a little wider at the front: it shows nights Available from early March 2027 (Not Available through 5 March, Available on 11 March; 6-10 March not probed). I wrote the agency's stated April opening; a March night the engine sells is outside the stated season.
Waterfront: stays not waterfront. NHD: Lick Island Run 176 m (a headwater draw below the ridge).
